notes.title: Localization into 12 LANGUAGES!
notes.content:
Mac Biskwi Adventures is localized into 12 languages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39671203/75e64439a8ef26ce027cf5cb825f6fa1990e348c.png[/img]

Here's the list of the supported languages:

- English
- French
- Portuguese
- Spanish
- Italian
- German
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Indonesian

Don't see your language here? Please, feel free to get in touch with us via Twitter DM and we'll do our best to include your language.

Don't be shy, we're friendly! :-)

Our social media accounts:

https://twitter.com/MacBiskwi
https://www.instagram.com/macbiskwi/
https://www.facebook.com/macbiskwiadventures
